source.name: U.S. Census Bureau: Census 2000 (Summary File 3, table P021), then the American Community Survey (table B05001), 1-year estimates for counties of 65,000 or more and 5-year estimates for the rest
notes: No 1-year figures for 2020: the pandemic cut that year's survey responses, so the Census Bureau released 2020 only as experimental estimates.
Counties listed in fiveYear use the 5-year survey: the figure for a year pools the five years ending then.
